description: Realized gains and losses from a pasted broker transactions export, split into short-term (held a year or less) and long-term by tax year, lots matched first-in, first-out, with sells that have no buy in the export set aside. Example questions: "How much short-term gain did I have this year?"; "Split my 2025 trades into short and long term"; "What are my capital gains?"

tax_year.description: One tax year (default: every year in the export)

transactions_csv.description: The transactions or gains/losses CSV from the broker, pasted as text (E*TRADE download, this repo's CSV, or plain columns date, action, symbol, quantity, price, fee)

name: short_vs_long_term_capital_gains
title: Short- vs Long-Term Capital Gains
